topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes, relates them to histopathology practicals, and outlines the lecture learning outcomes.

topics.label: Discovery and laboratory validation of transforming oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the historical discovery of viral and cellular transforming genes and describe the experimental assays used to demonstrate cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major categories of cancer mutations and illustrate their biochemical actions and phenotypic effects using the Rb pathway and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and forms of genetic instability in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how specific failures in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and mitotic segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential somatic mutation acquisition and inherited germline defects accelerate tumor development and shape cancer evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation, offers recommended reading, and previews the upcoming lecture on the hallmarks of cancer.
